claim: exit 0: no database records a collation version other than the one the OS provides, and a connect to cairn prints no mismatch warning
method: test -z "$(psql -d postgres -At -c "select datname from pg_database where datcollversion is not null and datcollversion <> pg_database_collation_actual_version(oid)" 2>&1)" && ! psql -d cairn -At -c 'select 1' 2>&1 | grep -q 'collation version mismatch'
horizon: after every OS release upgrade (glibc moves with it), and at a box's first cairn start after one
